title: in your mall world?zombies/disney vegas/flying/lucid
content: -zombies ? Always running into the mall to hide from them in the parking lot. Or into a car at night as they chase me. Sometimes upper lvls of mall are apartments. Sometimes it’s zombies inside sometimes outside sometimes both or neither. It is reached through the classic windy freeway that has spirals in the air and sometimes twenty lvls of car tunnels. I am from Seattle area so there is a roller coaster train that goes underwater to a boat. Then the freeway around the pier and themepark. Which reminds me does anyone’s mall world have underground -Vegas and -Disneyworld which can be reached by plane. When I ride planes or rocket ships in dream though my heart does flips but I have a disorder vesavegal lolol Can anyone leave tips on lucid? I just had my first one where realized and chose to fly but need advice on how to keep focused not to lose and go back to dreaming? It was like it needs to be my design, waiting to see what I was shown next brought me out of it and it felt like watching Skyrim load could see glitch behind clouds. #adhd #cute #girl Tyia 🛌
